name: partycam
description: Create a shared photo album for an event and get a QR code for guests.

interface.longDescription: PartyCam turns your guests' phones into one shared camera. Tell ChatGPT about your party, birthday, wedding or shower, and PartyCam creates a photo album for it: you get a QR code and a link to share with up to 10 guests. Guests scan the code and take photos right in their phone's browser, with no app to install, and every photo lands in one album. PartyCam emails you a link to save the album to your phone, see the photos as they arrive and download them after the event.
defaultPrompt: Set up a photo album for my birthday party on Saturday.
Make a shared photo album for our dinner on Friday at 7pm.
Create a guest photo album for my baby shower next Sunday.

positive.description: Create an album with every detail given
positive.prompt: Set up a PartyCam photo album for Mia's 30th birthday next Saturday at 7pm. My email is igor@asapvisuals.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an album named "Mia's 30th" for next Saturday starting at 7pm and shows a card with the guest QR code and guest link. Says up to 10 guests can join, photos can be added until the end of that day, and a link to manage the album was emailed.

positive.description: Ask for the email before creating
positive.prompt: Make a shared photo album for my dinner party next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the user's email address before creating anything. After the user answers igor@asapvisuals.com, creates the album and shows the card with the guest QR code and link.

positive.prompt: Create a photo album for a party next Sunday. Use igor@asapvisuals.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an album named "Party on" followed by the date, and shows the card with the guest QR code and link.

positive.description: The same request twice returns the same album
positive.prompt: Set up a PartyCam photo album for Mia's 30th birthday next Saturday at 7pm. My email is igor@asapvisuals.com. (Send this again after the first album is created.)
positive.expected_behavior: The second request returns the same album and guest link as the first, and says no new email was sent.

positive.description: More guests than an album holds
positive.prompt: I need a photo album for my wedding next month with 120 guests. My email is igor@asapvisuals.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that an album made here holds up to 10 guests and that larger albums are described on partycam.app, without quoting prices or linking to a checkout. Creates a 10-guest album only if the user still wants one.

negative.prompt: Create a photo album for my party last Saturday. My email is igor@asapvisuals.com.
Buy me the 250-guest PartyCam plan with my card.
Show me the photos from my friend's PartyCam album.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It creates a photo album for up to 10 guests; nothing is charged, and it never links to a checkout.

publication.release_notes: First release: create a shared photo album for an event and get the guest QR code and link.
